parameters.query:
SELECT 'shipping' AS kind, region AS name, small, medium, large, NULL::int AS price, NULL::text AS details FROM shipping_rates
UNION ALL
SELECT 'packing' AS kind, size AS name, NULL, NULL, NULL, price_php AS price, capacity || '; ' || inclusions AS details FROM packing_fees
UNION ALL
SELECT 'payment' AS kind, method_name AS name, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, account_number || ' (' || account_name || ')' AS details FROM payment_methods;
